stories.headline: Saudi Arabia drastically scales back NEOM megaproject, pivots toward data centers
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia is significantly downsizing its flagship NEOM megaproject after years of cost overruns and delays. The Line will be reduced from 170km to a much smaller development, and the project may pivot to becoming a data center hub rather than a futuristic city. The 2029 Asian Winter Games at Trojena have been postponed indefinitely.

stories.headline: Saudi Defense Minister tells US officials not striking Iran would 'embolden' regime
stories.summary: Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman, during his Washington visit, reportedly told US officials that failing to follow through on threats against Iran would strengthen Tehran's regime. This marks a shift from earlier Saudi public positions urging caution against escalation.

stories.headline: US approves $9 billion Patriot missile sale to Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: The US State Department approved a potential $9 billion foreign military sale of Patriot Advanced Capability-3 missiles to Saudi Arabia. The deal includes 730 PAC-3 missiles and related equipment, part of broader US arms sales to Middle East allies.

stories.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman told Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in a phone call that Saudi Arabia will not allow its airspace or territory to be used for military actions against Iran, as the US considers potential strikes.

stories.headline: Saudi Aramco issues $4 billion bond in first global debt market foray of 2026
stories.summary: Saudi Aramco launched a $4 billion four-tranche bond offering with maturities ranging from three to 30 years, drawing robust investor demand in the state oil company's first international bond issue this year.

stories.headline: Saudi PIF ends year-long PwC consultancy ban after hiring dispute
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund lifted its ban on new advisory contracts with PwC after a year-long freeze. The dispute arose when PwC tried to hire the chief internal audit officer from NEOM, prompting PIF to restrict new consulting work.

articles.title: Saudi PIF ends PwC consultancy ban

stories.headline: London court awards Saudi dissident £3 million in damages for state harassment
stories.summary: A London High Court ruled that Saudi Arabia must pay satirist Ghanem al-Masarir more than £3 million in compensation for assault and phone hacking. The judge found the Saudi government infected his phone with Pegasus spyware and orchestrated his 2018 attack outside Harrods.

stories.headline: Saudi Foreign Minister conducts diplomatic meetings with Austria and Poland
stories.summary: Prince Faisal bin Farhan held meetings with his Austrian and Polish counterparts, reviewing bilateral relations and cooperation opportunities. He also commented on Saudi-UAE relations, calling them 'critically important' for regional stability despite differences over Yemen.

stories.headline: Saudi PIF reaches $930 billion in assets, seeks greater domestic investment
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund achieved a new milestone with $930 billion in assets under management. The sovereign wealth fund is now approaching wealthy Saudi families to increase domestic investment in local projects as part of its strategic rebalancing.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia's PIF Reaches $930 Billion in Assets, Cementing Global Investment Powerhouse Status

stories.headline: OPEC+ maintains oil production levels unchanged for March
stories.summary: Eight OPEC+ countries agreed to keep oil production cuts in place for March, maintaining current output levels despite oil prices reaching six-month highs. The decision comes amid concerns about potential US military action against Iran affecting markets.

The rift is playing out in proxy conflicts across Yemen, Sudan, and Libya.
